newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Treasurer may return funds linked to China.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Treasurer may return funds linked to China.

text.p: California state Treasurer Matt Fong may return as much as $100,000 in questionable campaign contributions from an Indonesian entrepreneur, according to a published report on Tuesday.

Fong, who is preparing for a possible run for the U.S. Senate next year, is considering returning the donations following reports that the money may have originated in mainland China, the Los Angeles Times reported.
The contributions came from Ted Sioeng and Panda Estates Investment Inc headed by Sioeng's daughter, the Times said.
Fong, a Republican, told the Times he sent letters to Sioeng demanding assurances that the contributions did not come from the Chinese government or other foreign sources.
"If he gives me a satisfactory response, then we'll keep the dollars. If it's an unsatisfactory response from him, then I'll give it back," Fong said.
Fong's campaign manager was not immediately available to comment on the report.
